description: Schema-only #768 slice stacked on canonical API #808. Introduce a separate Engine-owned execution record for the Person-bound request, finalization capability hash, private trace/tool-result descriptors, usage and outcome with references to canonical user/public answer message UUIDs; no private execution fields are included in shared-history projections. Test-first DB FK/check/uniqueness validation, linkage without duplicating a public answer, nil Person rejection, legacy Message/rating/trace preservation, and guarded non-destructive rollback. No copying/backfill of existing traces or browser/agent exposure: zaq-emb.15 owns legacy migration/cutover, downstream routing owns actual execution writes. Action reuse: extend Conversations/Message schema associations and existing finalize_incoming contract, local-only persistence schema, not new agent Action. Read Engine/Agent guides (Agent if touching lib/zaq/agent), docs/action-reuse.md, testing handbook and documentation policy. No new-feature E2E before human UX approval.

comments.text: 2026-09-26 Action reuse assessment before code: existing Conversations.admit_incoming/finalize_incoming writes legacy execution_status/finalization_token_hash to Message.metadata and trace/tool artifacts to Message/MessageTraceArtifact, incompatible with public canonical fanout. Extend existing Message UUID references with an Engine-local ExecutionRecord schema; do not duplicate finalization operations or alter existing writers until zaq-emb.15 legacy migration/cutover. Inputs: canonical user Message, mandatory persisted Person, Base64 SHA-256 capability hash (never raw token), status pending/completed/failed, optional one public answer, private trace/tool-result/usage/outcome maps. DB constraints and changesets fail closed; FK restrict prevents orphaning; one public answer belongs to at most one run, multiple attempts may share a user message. No BO/agent/workflow consumer until trusted Engine execution path exists; no new Action/Registry exposure (private runtime state). Tests first: private/public separation, nil/nonexistent Person, invalid/duplicate capability and answer, status transitions, legacy reference preservation and guarded down. Read Conversations moduledoc and Engine guide; no lib/zaq/agent change planned.

title: [zaq-emb.3.3] Add private Person-bound execution records
